title: [AUG-211] Research: give action items the minimum context needed to understand them (structure → UX/UI → implementation task)
why_we_need_this:
When a conversation ends and transcription starts, the user reviews a list of action items that are only short titles plus an owner arrow (e.g. "Показать цепочку выводов — Them → Me", "Присылайте документы — Them → Them", "Получить ответы от Алены или Ольги", "проводить pre-compliance", "Предложить вам идею"). Without context it is impossible to tell what the task is about, who asked, why, or what "documents"/"idea" refers to — so the items cannot be triaged, edited or exported to Praxis with confidence, and the user has to dig through the transcript manually.

Each item is born from a specific moment in the transcript, so context is in principle recoverable. Important finding from a first look: the stored `ActionItem` (@server/src/types.ts, line ~178) has NO link to the transcript — only id, text, owner, source, createdAt, locked, manual, praxis, assistant. The extractor buffer in @server/src/services/liveActionItems.ts does know transcript line ids (`BufferEntry { id, speaker, text }`), but that link is dropped when the item is stored. The research must confirm this and decide how to keep the anchor.

The work goes in order: 1) solution structure, 2) UX/UI, 3) implementation task.
acceptance_criteria:
### Phase 1 — Solution structure
- [ ] Current data flow documented: where an item is born (live Groq extraction, local fallback, assistant `add_action_item`, manual add, post-transcription), what transcript data is available at that moment (line ids, timestamps, speaker), and where the link is lost — with file:line references.
- [ ] Anchor model chosen: how an item points to its source (transcript line id(s) / start–end time / quote span), how the anchor survives dedup/merge, model edits, user edits, the switch from live lines to the final whisper transcript (re-transcription, corrections from @server/src/services/transcriptCorrections.ts) and old sessions without anchors.
- [ ] Context content defined: what "minimum necessary context" means — e.g. 1–2 sentence "why/what" summary, the source quote, who asked whom, deadline/object if mentioned — and which of these are generated by LLM vs taken verbatim from the transcript.
- [ ] Generation strategy compared (at least 2 options, e.g. context at extraction time in the same Groq call vs a separate enrichment pass after transcription vs on-demand when the item is opened), with cost, latency, Groq rate-limit/consent impact (groqTextConsent, `liveLocalSlot`, corrector yield AUG-167) and offline/local-LLM fallback.
- [ ] Storage and API change described: new `ActionItem` fields, `action-items.json` version/migration, transcript.md "## Action items" section, Praxis export (@server/src/services/transcriptActionItems.ts — separate cards already attach the whole transcript; decide whether the item context replaces or complements it), august MCP `list_action_items`.

### Phase 2 — UX/UI
- [ ] Clickable HTML mockups (file:///D:/... links) of ActionItemsPanel in both places: live ACTION ITEMS column (300 px) and the TranscriptView card, showing the item with context collapsed and expanded, the "jump to the moment in the transcript" interaction (scroll + highlight line, play audio from timestamp if audio exists), and the states: context generating / unavailable / item without anchor (legacy).
- [ ] Mockups follow the brandbook: 0 border-radius, color priority schema (green = top, yellow = high, outline = normal, red = danger only), no diagnostics (no model names, scores, offsets) in user UI.
- [ ] Mockups reviewed and approved by the user before Phase 3.

### Phase 3 — Implementation task
- [ ] Research report saved in the repo (e.g. @artifacts/ or project-context) with the chosen option and rejected alternatives with reasons.
- [ ] One or more implementation tasks created on the board (SMART title, why, checklist criteria, order/dependencies), referencing the approved mockups and the report.
important_constraints:
- Research only: no production code changes in this task.
- Cross-platform: the solution must work the same on Windows and macOS; no platform-specific paths.
- Privacy: any extra text sent to Groq must stay inside the existing groqTextConsent scope (or the report must state that the consent text has to change).
- Action items keep priority over line correction (decision AUG-167); the solution must not add calls that starve extraction.
- Business rule: models never delete action items; locked/manual items are never changed by a model — context generation must respect locks (decide whether context of a user-edited item is regenerated).
- Must also cover Default-mode recordings without a Live Text client (AUG-200) and items added by the meeting assistant (AUG-199).
- Relevant context routes: transcription/live-transcription, frontend-design (Live columns, ActionItemsPanel), architecture (transcript.md Action items), ai-assistants (august MCP), preferences (groqLiveActionItems, consent).
- Give the user full file:///D:/... links to mockups, not bare @paths.
